This page collects the documents an instructor needs to run, extend, and maintain
this course site. All three live at the root of the repository so they're easy to
find from a file browser or GitHub.

## Setup and day-to-day use

**[README](https://github.com/naultran/interactive-lecture-test/blob/main/README.md)** —
installing Quarto, previewing the site locally, adding a lecture, adding a slide,
adding an activity, replacing fictional JSON data, adding images/video, changing the
theme, deploying to GitHub Pages, restoring an old version with Git, branching per
semester, and troubleshooting common classroom problems.

## Activity-by-activity reference

**[INTERACTIVITY-GUIDE.md](https://github.com/naultran/interactive-lecture-test/blob/main/INTERACTIVITY-GUIDE.md)** —
for every demonstration activity: the teaching question it supports, what students
manipulate, what recalculates, which file holds the data, which file holds the
behavior, how to replace the example, known technical limits, accessibility notes,
and approximate performance limits.

## What's practical in a static browser lecture

**[TECHNICAL-LIMITS.md](https://github.com/naultran/interactive-lecture-test/blob/main/TECHNICAL-LIMITS.md)** —
a plain-language breakdown of what's straightforward, what needs care, and what's
out of scope for a GitHub-Pages-only, no-backend lecture site, plus the specific
simplifications made in this template (dataset sizes, combined noise controls, no
UMAP, etc.).
